answer: Proof of space mitigates Sybil attacks by requiring agents to bind identities to cryptographically plotted sectors of non-volatile storage. Generating fake identities across a dormant cloud tundra forces an adversary to allocate unique disk space to each execution thread instead of recycling virtual instances behind a sable proxy, imposing linear storage costs. However, this mechanism favors industrial data centers with surplus drive bays over resource-constrained edge devices.
